name: ai-arcade
description: A Steam-like desktop app for free, AI-made games, backed by a small API server.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @ai-arcade/api" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-arcade/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @ai-arcade/api
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @ai-arcade/desktop
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
